comparison: Exact original question and maximality definition are now read. The latest primitive-multiple-scheme result changes the underlying scheme from X_n to X_(n+1) and assumes extension hypotheses; it does not maximally enlarge every open class of sheaves on one fixed variety with a global universal family. Earlier source gap is closed, and no full candidate was found.

The actual theorem requires torus-chart cohomology condition (H). It covers all H1=0 examples and selected other classes, but not every closed symplectic manifold. Exact universal Hofer bounded-commutator question and the special theorem were read. No complete matching announcement found.

sources.locator: Theorems 2.1–2.2/2.7, properties indexed by kappa > aleph0

comparison: The 2024 result separates weak-star SSD2P from ordinary SSD2P and proves ordinary SSD2P for a restricted family of Lipschitz spaces; it does not construct ordinary SSD2P without c0 or prove all-space containment. The transfinite theorems assume stronger cardinal properties and establish sum/tensor stability. Finite ordinary norm-dual slice implication remains distinct. Palomar Moore graphs hit is finite graph diameter, unrelated to Banach unit-ball slices.
